ui_bugs.issue: At mobile 390px viewport, the 'Also explore' cross-link <a> elements render at ~714px width inside a 350px parent grid cell, causing the whole /integrations/* page to horizontally scroll (document.scrollWidth=734 vs clientWidth=390). Root cause: the Link is a grid item but lacks min-w-0, so its intrinsic content width (long tagline inside .block.truncate span) blows out the grid track. The inner span uses truncate but overflow:hidden only engages when the parent is width-constrained — the Link itself needs min-w-0 (or the parent grid needs min-w-0 on items) so the flex child + truncate can clip properly.
ui_bugs.fix_hint: In /app/frontend/src/pages/Integration.jsx line ~333, add `min-w-0` to the Link className (e.g. 'group flex min-w-0 items-center gap-3.5 ...'). Also safe to add `min-w-0` to the inner span.block.text-sm.font-semibold if names ever grow.

rca_of_the_issue: Mobile overflow on /integrations/*: the cross-link Link is a CSS grid item; grid items default to min-width:auto so they are sized by their intrinsic content. The inner tagline span has `truncate` (nowrap+overflow:hidden) but that only takes effect once the ancestor flex/grid chain is width-constrained. Without `min-w-0` on the Link (and ideally on the inner name span too), the content's intrinsic width ~714px wins and the grid track grows, pushing document width to 734px at a 390px viewport. Fix: add `min-w-0` to the Link element's className.
